searchText: Do we need to prepare anything for ACDC tomorrow? Mainly just recommended gas numbers based on your benchmarks, so that all clients can come to consensus on the appropriate repricing Ok, this is simple because this is linear: so `k * multiplication_cost` Is multiplication_cost the cost for a regular scalar multiplication? yes Shouldn’t it be lower? Since doing multiple scalar multiplications and then adding the results together should be slower than using the pippenger algorithm to compute one large msm That's why addition is for free. I mean to say that the following should not have the same cost unless there is something wrong with the precompile: res = scalarMul(a_0, G_0) + scalarMul(a_1, G_1) vs res = msm([a_0, a_1], [G_0, G_1]) In the latter, it should be able to amortise the cost of the scalar multiplications across the two inputs in those case Unfortunately, we are not able to make BLST match this theory and execution is linear. Either someone shows me how to get sub-linear complexity using BLST or we are shipping linear costs. I'm curious have you tried this on different hardware? Blst is notorious for having different ARM paths and it seems that Apple is popular among Ethereum core devs The same is on Apple M3 Ahh yeah that's also ARM, can you run on intel? if you tell me what benches you're running I could try at home tomorrow I did run on recent Intel, my colleague on M3. Ohh I see, you are getting linear on AMD too, gotcha
